resources.string: Check the accelerometer here. During a warehouse shift, select tilt control: left sorts to A, right to C, and B needs explicit confirmation in neutral. Touch controls remain available.
No accelerometer. Screen controls remain available.
Sensor unavailable. Try enabling it again; screen controls still work.
The camera lets you check an image of a work badge. This version takes a real frame without recognizing QR codes. Images stay in memory, are not saved or sent to a server. Camera use is optional.
Camera permission was not granted. The game remains available. You can retry if Android allows another request.
No camera available. Warehouse work does not require it.
Could not capture a frame. The camera has been released. Try again.
Real camera image · Kept only until leaving this screen
